description: AmBIENCe2ABM processes European building-stock inputs for ArchetypeBuildingModel.jl. Topi Rasku publishes the Python package as part of the EU Mopo project. It combines AmBIENCe building typologies, Hotmaps heated floor-area maps and assumed ventilation properties into CSV-based Frictionless data packages and Spine Datastore import specifications. Coverage is EU-wide with reference-building and stock categories; Hotmaps floor-area inputs refer to 2015, while other source periods differ. The workflow generates static parameters, not hourly heating and cooling time series, which are produced in a separate downstream workflow. Code is free under MIT and processed data under CC BY 4.0. Raw AmBIENCe deliverables are excluded because their licence remains unclear. The documentation warns that heat-source distributions and some reference geometries are unreliable and that ventilation and infiltration require crude assumptions. These limitations favour aggregated exploratory scenarios over precise individual-building predictions. Simulation uses include preparing thermal archetypes and energy-demand inputs. The tool directly builds on data-hotmaps-building-stock-and-heat-density-maps; no scripts were executed or data packages imported during this review.
